title: User Signup with valid data
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register with valid input data and receives a JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the signup page
Enter valid user details (username, email, password)
Submit the signup form
Verify the user receives a valid JWT token and is redirected to a protected page

title: User Signup with invalid data
description: Ensure the signup form validates inputs and shows appropriate errors for invalid user data.

steps.description: Navigate to the signup page
Enter invalid user details (e.g., invalid email, weak password, missing username)
Submit the signup form
Verify validation error messages are displayed and no JWT token is issued

title: User login with correct credentials
description: Verify that existing users can login successfully with valid credentials and receive JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter valid username/email and password
Click login button
Check login is successful and JWT token is stored

title: User login with incorrect credentials
description: Verify login fails with invalid username or password and user is notified.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter incorrect username/email or password
Click login button
Verify login fails and error message is displayed

title: Access protected routes with valid JWT
description: Verify that a user with a valid JWT token can access protected routes successfully.

steps.description: Login and obtain valid JWT token
Attempt to access protected pages (e.g., dashboard)
Confirm access is granted and content is visible

title: Access protected routes without JWT or with invalid JWT
description: Ensure users without a valid JWT token cannot access protected routes and are redirected.

steps.description: Attempt to access protected routes without JWT or with expired/invalid JWT
Verify user is redirected to login page or receives unauthorized error

title: Browse services by category
description: Verify users can filter service listings by different categories and see relevant services.

steps.description: Login and navigate to Browse services page
Select a category filter from the listings UI
Confirm service list updates to show only services from selected category

title: Search services by keyword
description: Verify users can search services by keywords and receive accurate search results.

steps.description: Navigate to Browse services page
Input a search keyword in the search bar
Submit the search query
Validate that service listings update to match the search keyword

title: Real-time updates for new service listings
description: Verify users receive real-time updates via Socket.IO when new services are listed.

steps.description: Open Browse services page on client A
On client B, create a new valid service listing
Confirm client A receives a real-time notification and service list updates without refresh

title: Create new service listing with valid input
description: Ensure authenticated users can create a new service listing with valid form input.

steps.description: Login and navigate to List Service page
Fill in all required fields in the listing form (service name, description, category, etc.)
Submit the form
Verify new service is saved in the database and appears in the user's listings

title: Create service listing with invalid input
description: Validate form input rules and prevent creation of service listing if any input is invalid or missing.

steps.description: Login and navigate to List Service page
Leave required form fields empty or enter invalid data
Submit the form
Check for appropriate validation error messages and no new listing is created

title: Create trade offer successfully
description: Verify a logged-in user can create a trade offer on an available service and involved parties are notified.

steps.description: Login and browse available services
Select a service and initiate a trade offer
Submit the trade offer form
Confirm trade offer is recorded and real-time notifications via Socket.IO are sent to relevant users

title: Accept trade offer
description: Verify a trade offer recipient can accept the offer and both users see instant status updates in their dashboard.

steps.description: Login as the recipient of a trade offer
Locate pending trade offer in dashboard
Accept the trade offer
Validate trade status updates to accepted; both users’ dashboards reflect new status immediately

title: Decline trade offer
description: Verify recipient can decline a trade offer and relevant parties are notified with real-time update and dashboard refresh.

steps.description: Login as recipient of a pending trade offer
Decline the trade offer
Confirm trade status changes to declined and real-time notifications update all affected users' dashboards

title: Cancel trade offer
description: Verify an offer creator can cancel their trade offer before it is accepted and the system reflects the cancellation instantly.

steps.description: Login as creator of a pending trade offer
Cancel the trade offer
Validate trade status is updated to cancelled and all involved users receive real-time updates

title: Complete trade offer
description: Verify that trade offers can be marked completed by users and the final status is reflected in dashboards correctly.

steps.description: Login as either party of an accepted trade offer
Mark the trade offer as completed
Check the trade is flagged as completed and dashboards show updated final status instantly

title: Dashboard displays current user listings
description: Verify the user dashboard correctly shows the user’s active service listings with real-time updates.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the dashboard
Confirm all the user's current service listings are displayed accurately
Create or update a service listing from another client/session
Verify the dashboard updates immediately to reflect changes

title: Dashboard reflects user trades and statistics
description: Ensure the dashboard shows up-to-date trades statuses, trade counts, and statistics, updating in real-time.

steps.description: Login and open dashboard
Check trade lists and statistics (active, completed, declined, cancelled) are displayed correctly
On separate session, modify a trade status (accept, decline, complete, cancel)
Confirm dashboard reflects status change instantly via real-time update

title: Real-time trade offer notifications to multiple users
description: Validate that real-time Socket.IO messages propagate trade offer changes accurately to all involved parties’ clients.

steps.description: User A creates a trade offer to User B
User B receives an immediate notification
User B accepts or declines the offer
User A’s UI updates instantly reflecting the change

title: Form input validation prevents submission of malformed data
description: Verify that form inputs for service listing and trade offers reject invalid or malicious input and produce errors.

steps.description: Attempt to submit listing/trade forms with invalid formats (e.g. script injection, empty required fields)
Confirm input validations block submission and display meaningful error messages

title: Unauthorized attempts to create listings or trades are blocked
description: Ensure API endpoints reject attempts to create or modify resources without proper JWT authentication.

steps.description: Call API endpoints for creating listings and trades without sending JWT token
Verify server returns authentication error and no data changes
Call same endpoints with an expired or malformed JWT token
Confirm unauthorized errors are returned

title: Search returns no results for unmatched queries
description: Verify that entering search keywords that yield no matching services returns an empty list with a proper message.

steps.description: Navigate to Browse page and enter a nonsense search term
Submit the search
Confirm the service list is empty and a 'no results found' message is displayed

title: Handling trade offer on non-existent or already completed service
description: Verify system gracefully rejects trade operations on services that do not exist or whose trade status is final.

steps.description: Attempt to create a trade offer for a service that does not exist or is completed/cancelled
Verify API returns error and no trade is created
